entries.what: Thao finishes her Monday night shift on 4 West, then gets home to unit 207 as Tomás leaves for work. After a few hours of sleep she designs a color-coded fridge whiteboard chore chart.
entries.outcome: The whiteboard goes up: Tomás takes dishes and trash, she takes laundry and groceries.

entries.what: Thao packs rice and a thermos of cà phê sữa đá, takes the nurse shuttle from the gravel overflow lot and works Monday night on 4 West.
Thao finishes her night shift, sleeps 8:30 to 3 behind the blackout curtains and box fan, then does laundry with her reloaded card.
entries.outcome: Laundry done, sleep mostly caught up.

entries.what: Thao works Tuesday night on 4 West, and Rubén shares a charting shortcut.
entries.outcome: Quiet night, charting done on time.

entries.what: After shift Thao sleeps, then picks up groceries at Ruiz Family Market and sees Tomás has done the dishes per the whiteboard. She books the overdue dental cleaning at the Plaza Marisol dentist for Nov 18 at 3:30 p.m.
entries.outcome: Dentist appointment booked; fridge chart working.

entries.what: Thao has a day off and rewatches her baking show to wind down, then goes to bed early.
Thao researches CE courses to finish her hours; when the assistant asks a clarifying question she says to bullet it.
entries.outcome: Gets a short bulleted list of CE options.

entries.what: Thao waters the pothos and struggling basil on the balcony and hears Theo crying through the wall, so she puts in earplugs.
Thao works Friday night on 4 West. Halloween brings trick-or-treaters through Marisol Gardens, so she leaves candy out with Tomás before the shuttle.
entries.outcome: Candy handed out; shift quiet apart from a few staff in costume.

entries.what: At 2 a.m. Thao eats her packed leftover rice and what Hạnh sent.
Thao gets home after shift and sleeps until mid-afternoon, skipping a call from Hạnh at 1 p.m.
Thao sends Linh her $50 for groceries and texts her to check on school.
Thao walks the Ulloa marsh boardwalk before the evening, then goes to bed early.
Thao sleeps in, then does laundry and checks the whiteboard; Tomás has done the trash.
Sunday dinner at Hạnh's Pell Road house with Linh.
entries.outcome: Hạnh asks about pharmacy; Thao steers the talk elsewhere.

entries.what: Thao drives home in her hatchback with the slow passenger tire and prepares for Monday's shift.
